metadata.description: Son of Tata and Tatië, the second Elf-father and his spouse. Born at Cuiviénen during the Years of the Trees. Brother of Maidros. He is an ancestor of the Tatyarin Avari – those Noldor who did not undertake the Great Journey to Aman but remained behind with Morwë and/or Nurwë. His descendants became part of the Avari (the 'Unwilling') who never saw the light of the Two Trees in Valinor.
